sequence_points.name: Ocean Sunset Landscape
sequence_points.description: A vertical painting depicting a dramatic ocean sunset with vibrant orange and pink hues in the sky transitioning into deep blue clouds above turbulent waves. The artwork is mounted on a wall, slightly angled, showing a dynamic seascape composition.

sequence_points.name: Abstract Composition with Vertical Forms
sequence_points.description: A vertically oriented abstract painting featuring blurred, elongated forms in muted tones of gray, white, and subtle brown. The composition appears layered, with soft transitions between shapes, mounted on a wall in a gallery setting.

sequence_points.name: Abstract Composition with Blue and Gray Tones
sequence_points.description: A vertically oriented abstract painting featuring dominant blue and gray hues with subtle textural variations. The composition includes layered brushwork and a central darker vertical element, mounted on a museum wall.

sequence_points.name: Landscape with River and Windmill
sequence_points.description: A pastoral landscape painting featuring a winding river, green fields, trees, and a prominent windmill in the distance. The scene is rendered in soft earth tones with a hazy sky, suggesting a serene rural setting.
